description: Returns an indicative quote for sending money with Morse from a person living in from_country to someone else's bank account in to_country: the amount sent, the fee, the mid-market exchange rate and what the recipient gets. The result includes the total cost of the transfer and the typical delivery time. Use it to answer how much a transfer costs or how much will arrive. Use list_send_destinations first to check the destination is offered. Present the figures as indicative and tell the user to check the final rate and fees in the Morse app, using get_started_url.

amount.description: Amount to send, in from_currency, e.g. 250 or 99.50.

from_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the sender lives in, e.g. US. If the user has not said where they live, ask them before quoting; do not assume.

from_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the sender pays in. Defaults to the currency of from_country.

to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country of the recipient's bank account, e.g. MX.

to_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the recipient receives. Defaults to the currency Morse pays out in to_country.

name: quote_send
